title: Effects of organic ligands, phosphate and Ca on the structure and composition of Fe(III)-precipitates formed by Fe(II) oxidation at near-neutral pH
content:

Ville V. Nenonen, Ralf Kaegi, Stephan J. Hug, Jörg Luster, Jörg Göttlicher, Stefan Mangold, Lenny H. E. Winkel, Andreas Voegelin
The type and concentration of dissolved organic carbon in combination with phosphate, calcium and other solutes determine the structure and composition of Fe(III)-precipitates formed by Fe(II) oxidation in near-neutral bicarbonate-buffered waters.
